items.title: 完成三方 Host 分析证据采集
items.context: 分别获取两个 Claude CLI 视角和 Codex CLI host 视角，对附件能力、现有 Lattice 能力、host-neutral 边界和真实缺口进行独立判断；该 item 的完成信号是本地可引用的多 host 分析 artifact/摘要，而不是最终方案文档本身。
items.userSees: "Multi-host analysis: Claude-A / Claude-B / Codex conclusions recorded, disagreements listed, unsupported claims marked uncertain."

happy.desc: 多 host 分析 artifact 明确列出 Claude-A、Claude-B、Codex 的结论、分歧点与可引用出处。

edge.desc: 若某 host 无法直接验证附件或能力，artifact 必须记录限制、替代观察路径与未验证边界，而不是补写成等价结论。

adversarial.desc: artifact 必须区分已观察事实与推测，未被 transcript 或文档支持的能力判断要标为不确定或排除。

verificationEvidence.command: omx ask claude (Claude-A), omx ask claude (Claude-B), codex exec -C /Users/jek/Documents/Work/Orchestrate/.worktrees/B-f1d3 -s read-only -o .omx/artifacts/lifecycle-memory-codex-B-f1d3.md ...
verificationEvidence.note: The Multi-host analysis table cites Claude-A, Claude-B, and Codex artifacts and records each host conclusion plus disagreement handling.
The synthesis records limits from skeptical review and Codex read-only analysis, including unsupported Codex/Gemini subprocess support and non-authoritative host transcript boundaries.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "authority-preserving|Host 是证据来源|不能变成 production authority|不能被宣传为已可真实派发" Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md
verificationEvidence.note: The final document separates observed host evidence from Lattice authority and excludes unsupported claims instead of converting them into current capabilities.

items.title: 完成 Lattice 当前能力与真实缺口判断
items.context: 基于附件、三方 host 分析、现有真相源和代码 surface，判断哪些能力已经存在、哪些只是命名/叙事差异、哪些是真实 correctness 或逻辑一致性缺口；明确排除任意优化和未授权 authority 扩张。
items.userSees: "Current capability map: existing surfaces, narrative-only deltas, real gaps, and non-goals are separated with source references."

happy.desc: 能力判断把事项分成已存在能力、命名或叙事差异、真实缺口、非目标项，并给出当前 truth source 或代码 surface 依据。

edge.desc: 对证据不足或边界模糊的项，结论必须显式写成条件性或待验证，不得强行归类为已有或缺口。

adversarial.desc: 任何优化诉求、未授权 authority 扩张或仅 host 体验差异，不能被误判为 correctness 缺口。

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "True correctness / logic gaps|Non-goals|当前能力对比|Host-neutral lifecycle infrastructure" Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md
verificationEvidence.note: The document separates existing lifecycle surfaces, true correctness gaps, and non-goals with references to Lattice truth-source docs.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "只有在真实恢复失败被证明时才算 gap|未来待证实 gap|不能被宣传为已可真实派发|待验证" Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md
verificationEvidence.note: Ambiguous or insufficiently proven capabilities are written as conditional future gaps or excluded from current capability claims.
The document explicitly rejects arbitrary optimization, authority expansion, and host-experience differences as correctness gaps.

items.title: 产出执行方案文档与测试策略
items.context: 在完成高风险 PLAN 的 understanding/decision/preMortem 和 verificationIntent 准备后，将可行性判断、阶段化实施方案、测试/验证矩阵、文档落点写入 Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md；方案必须保持 gate evidence authority 与 dev-memory advisory boundary 的一致性。
items.userSees: "Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md contains feasibility, staged execution plan, and validation matrix without authority-boundary drift."

happy.desc: 最终文档存在且包含可行性结论、阶段化执行方案、测试或验证矩阵，并把验证项映射到 docs_check、manual_transcript 或 cli 证据类型。

edge.desc: 若某阶段或验证点无法自动化，方案必须明确记录人工 transcript 或文档校验作为暂定证据路径及适用范围。

adversarial.desc: 测试策略不得把 dev-memory advisory 或非 gate 事实当作 gate evidence，且方案必须保持 gate evidence authority boundary 一致。

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "^# Lattice Lifecycle Memory Evolving|^## 执行结论|^## 执行计划|^## 测试矩阵|manual_transcript|docs_check|cli" Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md
verificationEvidence.note: The final file exists and contains feasibility conclusion, staged execution plan, and validation matrix with docs_check, manual_transcript, and cli evidence types.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "manual_transcript|若后续 story|只有在跨 host handoff 真实恢复失败可复现时做|经真实失败证明" Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md
verificationEvidence.note: The plan records manual transcript paths for host analysis and limits non-automated future recovery evidence to proven failures and bounded follow-up stories.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "gateEvidence:false|productionDone=false|不能让 `productionDone=true`|auto-DONE|authority" Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md && git show --check --stat --oneline HEAD -- Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md
verificationEvidence.note: The test strategy preserves dev-memory advisory and gate authority boundaries, and the committed document has no whitespace or patch formatting issues.
The story branch .gitignore only exposes current story metadata needed for Koala commits while historical story metadata and runtime artifacts remain ignored.
